name: Zoku Hitou Meguri
source:
Main character falls in love with a woman on a travel pamphlet. However, her face is hidden, so identity remains concealed. He decides to visit this hot springs ryokan in attempt to find the woman.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公爱上了旅游宣传册中的一名女子。然而，她的脸被遮住，身份依然成谜。为了寻找这名女子，他决定前往宣传册上的温泉旅馆。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-june-2007-koisuru-otome-to.html]vndbreview[/url]]
